Type.tooltip: Node class (names from the game): 0 Parallel (children run together), 1 Condition (child runs while the expression is true), 2 SubFxSystem (did not render in items in game tests), 3 UpdateVar (assigns a variable), 4 ParticleEmitter, 5 SoundEmitter. Multiple emitters per system work in game.

U02.label: Local offset
U02.tooltip: LocalOffsetExpr: float3 position offset that rotates with the item, tested in game. Nadeo end sparklers: float3(0,0,5) / float3(0,0,10).

U03.label: World offset
U03.tooltip: WorldOffsetExpr: float3 position offset in world axes (ignores the item rotation), tested in game. Animated offsets work, e.g. float3(cos(Time/700)*5,0,sin(Time/700)*5).

U04.label: Expression U04
U04.tooltip: One of OpacityExpr, ScaleExpr, WaterTopExpr, LinearVelInWExpr (names from the game). 0, 3, 10, +-50 and cos(Time/500) showed no visible difference on GPU particles in game.

U05.label: Spawn rate multiplier
U05.tooltip: SpawnFreqModifierExpr: multiplies the rate, <= 0 stops emission, tested in game. Nadeo sparklers pulse with cos(Time/500). Expression; Time is in milliseconds.

U06.label: Expression U06
U06.tooltip: One of OpacityExpr, ScaleExpr, WaterTopExpr, LinearVelInWExpr (names from the game). 0, 3, 10, +-50 and cos(Time/500) showed no visible difference on GPU particles in game.

U07.label: Ambient light
U07.tooltip: LAmbientExpr (name order guessed): brightness, 0 dark/brown, 0.3 darker, 3 brighter, tested in game. Expression; Time is in milliseconds.

U08.label: Up
U08.tooltip: UpExpr: float3 up direction of the emitter. Expression; Time is in milliseconds.

U09.label: Direction (DOV)
U09.tooltip: DOVExpr: float3 forward direction of the emitter; particles travel along -DOV (default float3(0,0,-1) emits towards +Z), tested in game. Rotating it works, e.g. float3(cos(Time/400),0,sin(Time/400)).

U10.label: Expression U10
U10.tooltip: One of OpacityExpr, ScaleExpr, WaterTopExpr, LinearVelInWExpr (names from the game). 0, 3, 10, +-50 and cos(Time/500) showed no visible difference on GPU particles in game.

U11.label: Expression U11
U11.tooltip: One of OpacityExpr, ScaleExpr, WaterTopExpr, LinearVelInWExpr (names from the game). 0, 3, 10, +-50 and cos(Time/500) showed no visible difference on GPU particles in game.

U12.label: Direction in local space
U12.tooltip: DOVAndUpAreLocalSpace: 1 = Up and Direction rotate with the item, 0 = world axes, tested in game.

U14.label: Hue
U14.tooltip: LinearHue01: hue in [0;1], outside = no hue (-1). Needs UseEmitterHue + UseHueShift on the GPU model. Particles keep the hue they were born with: frac(Time/3000) cycles a rainbow, rand01() gives random colours, tested in game. DecorationColorHSL.x gave plain red in items.

U15.label: Hue lightness
U15.tooltip: HueLightness in [0;1]: <0.5 darker, >0.5 lighter; only while Hue is inside [0;1], tested in game.

Condition.tooltip: Expression; the child runs while it is true ('Time < 0' hid the emitter, 'Time >= 0' showed it, tested in game). Nadeo: UISequence == 'Podium'.

VariableName.tooltip: Variable (declared in the system's Vars) that this node assigns, tested in game.

Expression.tooltip: Value assigned to the variable every update, e.g. cos(Time/250). Functions: min max select lerp pow sqrt sqr clamp sat sin cos tan frac abs sign dot cross len normalize rand(min,max) rand01 smoothstep(a) atan2 ...

U01.label: Reset to default if inactive
U01.tooltip: Name from the game (ResetToDefaultIfInactive), order guessed.

U02.label: Default value (float bits)
U02.tooltip: Float stored as integer bits for float variables: 1061645451 = 0.779 (Nadeo Hue default).

U10.label: Range (float bits)
U10.tooltip: Float stored as integer bits; Nadeo: 1065353216 = 1.0.

InputClassId.tooltip: Expression context class (ExtraContextClassId?). 0xFFFFFFFF = none (Time still works). Nadeo uses 789434368 (0x2F0D8000) for UISequence / DecorationColorHSL; in items DecorationColorHSL.x gave plain red (not available).

OutputClassId.tooltip: Class id of the input/output object. Nadeo's fx systems use 0xFFFFFFFF (none); 0 is not a valid class.
